text:
I'm so sorry. Chasing this three times with no answer is exactly the experience we don't want you to have, and your frustration is completely fair. Your claim should have been reviewed within 2 business days, and a week of silence isn't acceptable.

**I'm escalating this to a Support Lead now**, since this is the third time you've raised it. They will track down your claim and make sure it gets reviewed. I can't see claim statuses from here, and I don't have a confirmed timeframe for their reply, so I won't guess. I'd rather be honest than promise something I can't back up.

**To help them find your claim quickly, please send:**
- Your order number (LF- followed by six digits)
- The date you submitted the claim, if you remember it

You can also email help@leafy.example with the same details, which is answered within 1 business day.

The **one-time $15 Leafy store credit** I mentioned for the delay is still yours, whatever happens with your claim.

Thank you for your patience, and I hope your bird of paradise pulls through. Please reach out any time. 🌿
